landing.heroBody: The operating system for Morocco's car-rental agencies — trust, fleet and finance in one place. Know a renter's history before you hand over the keys.
landing.featuresTitle: Four moving parts. One system of record.
landing.featuresBody: Trust, finance, compliance and fleet-sharing — the whole agency on a single spine, so nothing lives in a spreadsheet or a group chat.
landing.featureTrustBody: Privacy-hashed CIN (HMAC-SHA256) plus a cross-agency review score — collective renter trust, not a credit bureau.
landing.featureFinanceBody: MAD invoicing with 20% VAT, security deposits, and PAID / PARTIAL / DUE reconciliation to the cent.
landing.featureComplianceBody: Document-expiry enforcement and inspection gates stop a non-compliant car — or an unverified renter — before handover.
landing.featureHubBody: Share fleet across the agency network so an idle car earns from demand sitting at another agency.
landing.statMadLabel: Native ledger — reconciled to the cent
landing.ctaTitle: Be a founding agency on the network.
landing.ctaBody: The trust graph gets stronger with every agency that joins — and founders shape the signal everyone else inherits. Come see it on your own fleet.
landing.footerBlurb: The operating system for Morocco's car-rental agencies. Trust, fleet and finance on one spine.

diagnostics.title: Vehicle diagnostics
diagnostics.description: Review OBD evidence, record tests, confirm findings and prepare a manual repair estimate.
diagnostics.honestDescription: Simulator sessions are training evidence. Analysis uses deterministic rules and is not a confirmed diagnosis. Live hardware, OEM procedures, verified parts fitment and AI providers are not connected.
diagnostics.permissionDescription: Ask your agency owner to grant diagnostic access or the Technician preset in Staff & Access.
diagnostics.noVehicles: Add a diagnostic vehicle below to begin.
diagnostics.vehicleSeparate: Diagnostic vehicles are separate from rental inventory. Adding one does not make it available for rent.
diagnostics.viewOnly: You can view diagnostics. Performing tests and making decisions require additional permissions.
diagnostics.selectSessionDescription: Create a vehicle and session, then run a reproducible simulator scenario to explore the technician workflow.
diagnostics.simulatedEvidence: SIMULATED — training evidence, not live vehicle data
diagnostics.importedEvidence: IMPORTED — packet origin must be verified by the technician
diagnostics.simulatorDescription: Choose a scenario and seed. The same inputs reproduce the same simulated measurements; no physical adapter is connected.
diagnostics.newSessionForScenario: Create another session to compare a different scenario without mixing evidence.
diagnostics.requiresPerform: Performing diagnostics requires the diagnostics.perform permission.
diagnostics.evidenceDescription: Values are decoded from validated packets. Late or clock-drifted observations are labeled for review. Recorded codes are evidence, not a repair instruction.
diagnostics.noEvidence: Run a simulator scenario to capture evidence.
diagnostics.noDtc: No codes recorded in this session. This does not establish vehicle safety.
diagnostics.analysisDescription: Rule-based hypotheses explain their evidence and limitations. Test suspected causes before confirming a finding.
diagnostics.noAnalysis: Capture evidence, then analyze it to see hypotheses.
diagnostics.noFindings: No supported rule hypothesis. Record any remaining uncertainty in your confirmation notes.
diagnostics.confirmationDescription: Select only findings supported by your tests. Confirmation records your authenticated identity and notes; it does not certify roadworthiness.
diagnostics.attestation: I reviewed the evidence, recorded the tests I performed, and understand whether this session is simulated or imported.
diagnostics.estimateDescription: Prices are entered by your agency. This is a quote, not an invoice or payment. Parts fitment and availability have not been verified.
diagnostics.vatAssumption: Default assumption: 0.20 = 20% VAT, added to prices excluding VAT. Confirm the rate before saving.
diagnostics.requiresEstimate: Saving estimates requires the diagnostics.estimate permission.
diagnostics.savedEstimate: Saved estimate totals — unsaved edits are not included
diagnostics.reportDescription: The report preserves evidence, uncertainty, simulation provenance, technician confirmation and your saved manual estimate.
diagnostics.reportPrerequisites: Confirm findings and save an estimate before generating a report. A generated report is a snapshot; start a new session for new evidence.
diagnostics.visionDescription: Automated image analysis is unavailable. No damage detections, confidence scores or repair decisions are produced until a real provider is configured and validated.

errors.permission: You do not have permission for this action. Ask your agency owner to review your diagnostic access.
errors.conflict: This session changed. The latest evidence was refreshed. Review it before submitting your decision again.
errors.missing: This session is unavailable in your agency. Refresh the session list.
errors.network: The request could not be completed. Check your connection and try again.
errors.invalid: Check the submitted values and try again.

diagnostics.confirmationPrerequisites: Record a conclusive test for every selected finding. All urgent findings must be addressed before confirmation.
diagnostics.aiUnconfigured: Optional AI explanation is not configured. The evidence and rule-based workflow remain available.
diagnostics.aiExplanationDescription: Optional AI prose cannot confirm a diagnosis or add evidence. Verify its suggestions against the recorded evidence.
diagnostics.aiUnavailable: The AI explanation is unavailable. Continue with the saved evidence and rules.
diagnostics.freezeFrameUnavailable: Freeze frame unavailable — no captured readings were supplied.
diagnostics.estimatePrerequisites: Confirm the technician findings before entering and saving an estimate.
diagnostics.evidenceCountRecent: Showing latest {shown} of {total} validated packets. All packets remain in the session.
diagnostics.evidenceCountAll: Showing all {total} validated packets. Scroll within the table to review them.
diagnostics.evidenceExportDescription: Evidence JSON includes every packet and its provenance. This is separate from the finalized report.
diagnostics.evidenceTableRegion: OBD packet measurements — scroll to review
